verdict.correctness: PASS: every one of the 4 micro x 5 group input_ids/attention_mask pairs fed to the model is byte-identical between modes (fed_hash); loss max abs dev 0.0096, inside the native run-to-run band; zero loss outliers in either mode (the round-54 outliers were caused by the shared-FIFO bug, NOT by an unsafe tokenizer - that claim is WITHDRAWN)
verdict.performance: CONSISTENT GAIN: 12/12 paired steps faster with prefetch; median -25.2 ms (range -8.7 .. -34.7) = ~1.20% of a ~2.1 s step; direction independent of run order (A->B and B->A both negative)
verdict.mechanism: ~11-12 ms/step of host tokenize is genuinely hidden (measured overlap 32-36 ms per 3-step run), and unlike round-54 the hidden time now translates into whole-step savings
verdict.training_impact: Candidate for adoption: preserves training semantics and precision, stable whole-step gain, no kernel change needed. Still hardware_status=unverified; needs the remaining sign-off (records artifact, PCM) before deployable.
